rules.text: Publications that describe the use of methodologies, approaches, principles, and practices of software engineering in AI or ML system development.
Publications that describe the use of methodologies, approaches, principles, and practices of software engineering for the development of AI or ML models.

Publications that describe an AI software that includes an ML component to perform intelligent functions and mention the use of software engineering methodologies, approaches, principles, and practices.
Publications that describe the definition of model development or experimental pipelines covering requirements engineering, data, training, and evaluation processes.
Publications that do not meet any of the inclusion criteria.
Publications in which the language is different from English or Portuguese.
Publications that are not available for reading or data collection (publications that are only accessible via payment or are not provided by the search engine).
Publications that focus on algorithmic aspects of AI/ML systems, but not engineering aspects.
Publications that theoretically discuss or propose practices or methods without empirical validation.
Publications about the use of AI/ML for improving software engineering practices.
Publications that are short papers and systematic review studies that did not perform an empirical study.
